id.description: User ID, serves as the primary key.

pixels.description: A JSON object storing pixel data, e.g. {"x,y": "color"}

last_updated.description: Timestamp of the last update to this layer, used for sorting.

unlocked_colors.description: An array of hex color strings the user has unlocked.

database.instructions: Each user has a single record in the 'user_layers' table, keyed by their user ID. The 'pixels' column contains a JSON object mapping 'x,y' coordinates to hex color strings. 'unlocked_colors' stores an array of hex colors the user can use.
